answer: Anchor each identity to an aged external credential: require proof of control over an account with years of organic history elsewhere - an old code repository, a long-held number, a tenured domain. Such histories take real time to grow, so a farm cannot mint a thousand of them this month. Trust then rests on an atlas of verifiable pasts, each record a crystal formed slowly, and the identities with the deepest history climb to the zenith of the reward tiers.
